data.name: Mustaque
data.gender_notes: Mustaque is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mustaque is a Hindi and Urdu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mukta' meaning 'Lord of the treasury'. This name is a sign of wealth and prosperity. It is believed that Mustaque brings good fortune, financial success, and material abundance. The name Mustaque carries the meaning “Lord of the treasury” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu. Parents who choose Mustaque usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the treasury and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mustaque is a spiritual name representing the inner richness and abundance of the soul. It symbolizes the pursuit of wealth not just in material terms, but also in terms of knowledge, wisdom, and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Mustaque belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the treasury.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mustaque total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
